# task\-guard\-branch\-ledger\-commits — Reject \.waystation/ changes committed on feature branches
status: todo  priority: 3  scope: scope-git
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

README and ADR\-0003 say feature branches must not commit or merge their checkout\-local \.waystation/ snapshot, but nothing enforces it\. Add an enforcement point \(pre\-commit hook and/or CI check, optionally a validate diagnostic\) that flags \.waystation/\*\* changes on branches other than the coordination branch, so stray branch\-local ledger writes cannot silently diverge or be merged over the shared ledger's history\.

## Acceptance
- A commit on a non\-coordination branch that touches \.waystation/\*\* is rejected or flagged with an actionable message naming the shared ledger root\.
- Commits from the coordination checkout are unaffected\.
- The check is documented in README alongside the shared\-ledger instructions\.
